notes: Read by bootstrap/get.ps1 so that 'irm <url> | iex' can resolve a version and a hash without arguments, which a bare pipe cannot supply.
'latest' is what the one-liner installs when no version is given. It must name an entry in 'releases'.

A release is recorded here AFTER it is published, not before. The hash describes the bytes actually uploaded to the release, and archives are not byte-reproducible yet, so a rebuild of the same commit will not match. Never edit a recorded hash to make a rebuild agree - publish a new version instead.
Recording the hash in git is the integrity story. Substituting a release asset would require also editing this file, which leaves a commit behind.
'tagCommit' is the commit the release tag points at, which is verifiable independently. It is not a claim that the archive is reproducible from that tree.
